keyFindings.description: No `## Contract change census`, although the PR adds a refusal at a process boundary (`versions=<other>` now answers 400 INVALID_QUERY where it answered 200). Add one: the search commands for every sender of the references route with a query (packages/*/src, packages/dispatch/web, packages/claude-envoy/dist, scripts/, the production access log of 2026-10-28), every hit with its disposition, and the rollout line (immediate, naming what the refusal closes: a misspelled value silently getting the 2.4 MB full answer).

The lateral subquery copies by hand the raw columns versionColumns (artifacts.go:1267) and model.VersionSize (model.go:740) read, v.markdown included. A column added to versionColumns breaks only the versions=latest statement (500), the path only the CLI takes. Project the row (`select * from artifact_versions v ... limit 1`) or derive the list from the shared constant.

The file grows from 847 to 1,044 lines, and the trimmed-answer test builds the 160-document, 6,421-version fixture a second time though none of its checks depend on size. Move the fixture, seedReferenceDocumentHistory/referenceAuthorLists and the two tests that use it into their own file, and build the fixture once (subtests) or give the trimmed test a small fixture; name the 2,205 and 1,000,000 thresholds with their reason.

A repeated versions parameter takes its first value: ?versions=latest&versions=bogus answers 200, while the docs say any other value is 400. asks.go:564 and server.go:430 refuse a repeated parameter; do the same, or document first-value-wins.

The rewritten description keeps 'Cross-references to and from an issue', but refs.Closure (refs/closure.go:25) follows references outward only; the route index serves this text to agents. Say 'the eight-hop closure of documents the issue's content references', as the README and AGENTS rows do.
